P5 B3R set-aware minus random FS@2 = −0.025 [−0.058,+0.010] at 2 labels/q and −0.027 [−0.057,−0.000] at 5 on 200 DEV questions. Bootstrap resamples queries after 3-seed averaging, not independent training runs; multiple comparisons unadjusted.

P5 B3R five-label teacher input tokens differ: random 971,006 versus set-aware 1,252,556 (+29%). Student is a frozen-encoder residual adapter with closed 10-passage candidate sets; no evidence for full bi-encoder or open-corpus gains.
The original P5 400-question pilot holdout is exposed. Clean independent and open-pool HotpotQA/MuSiQue transfer remain unverified; SCARLet, PRD, DISCo and SetR narrow novelty.
Public site is a dated static research snapshot, not live job telemetry. A checkpoint, pending job or GPU allocation is not an observed student-retrieval improvement.

audit.methodology: C5 full bi-encoder D3 preserves 256/64 sequence lengths and D2 effective batch via accumulation; D4 splits seeds 17/29/41 into separate output-owned GPU jobs. Paired nDCG/CI must be computed once after all six gold/KD fits. C6 completed NFCorpus teacher pairs but no 3-seed cross-domain student outcome. P5 B3R CIs bootstrap 200 DEV questions after averaging three seeds (seed variance omitted), with selection heuristics rather than a true boundary-aware oracle, residual adapter student, and unadjusted comparisons.
audit.split_integrity: P1 C5 SciFact 505 train, INNER 100, 200 HOLDOUT previously exposed at C2 and reserved for G5; no early read of seed17's final holdout metrics in the native report. C6 official NFCorpus test 323 and FiQA test 648 queries, reserved for final evaluator; no test metric. P5 B3R TRAIN 1000 sampled from 6742, DEV 200, split manifest frozen; prior 400-question pilot holdout exposed and excluded from new claims. New 2000-question P5 holdout remains unverified as a confirmatory result.
audit.cost: P1 C6 NFCorpus MedCPT teacher scored 100,000 candidate pairs, FiQA teacher and end-to-end GPU-hours not yet finalized; C5 reuses pinned teacher scores. P5 B3R 9,857 physical union teacher endpoints, but per-arm uncached costs: 2 labels random 508,381 input tokens, set-aware 508,091; 5 labels random 971,006 versus set-aware 1,252,556 (+29%). Pair budget alone is not matched token cost.
audit.novelty: P1 learning from expensive teacher selection has GPL, PairDistill and related precedents; P5 set interaction utility overlaps SCARLet and efficient pairwise distillation overlaps PRD; DISCo and SetR challenge inference-time novelty. B3R set-aware ranking/diversity heuristic is not the proposed sufficiency-boundary acquisition. No A* or new method claim is established.
